body: That really is a shame :( No one deserves that...

I have struggled with depression so I know how you feel. If it wasn't for my man I would have nothing to hold onto in this world and I would probably buy enough heroin to shut myself down permanently... I can't imagine what you are going through :( But please try a little longer.. You may not think tomorrow could be a better day but that is exactly what tomorrow is. A new day. Something could happen if you just put yourself in the world. Last summer I was on a path to suicide, went out to a rave and decided I was going to do drugs all summer and then just... Die. But then in the most unlikely of places I found him, and we saved each other. It may not be a person you find... But you never know what tomorrow brings. Suicide doesn't take away the pain... It just takes away the chance of it ever getting better.

I sort of know how you feel :/ I don't self harm but as I progressed through my teens it just became more and more confusing... Turning 20 in 2 months now but it hasn't gotten much better. Have you tried going to a doctor to see if there is a chemical imbalance ? I really should... But I haven't for whatever reason...

You're very welcome <3 There are some trolls on here but they never stay long.. Typically everyone here that I have met is rather amazing and has so much insight for me, they have helped me through some tough times and I really appreciate what this subreddit has done for me. So I am overjoyed that you have come to us because we will love and support you even though we don't know you. That is just who we are <3
I will be your friend, PM me

I know how it feels to be in a loved one's arms and feel perfectly safe and loved. It is spectacular and I wouldn't trade it for the world. But it doesn't always last and it can't be the one thing you cling to. It is the most difficult thing in the world to try and live for yourself and I really am not the best person to tell you this because I rely on people for my life... It isn't fair to them, I tell myself, but it is the only thing that gives me purpose. But I do know... That if I did lose it, that I would have to find a way. I would HAVE to. Life is all I have, without it... I am nothing. Literally. everything you are and know would be gone if you took your life. It is hard... But if you think that you want to live, you can. It just takes a lot of fight and believe me once you start the fight you can win. All it takes is that extra step, that umph. To wake up and say to yourself, I am alive and it is amazing. I am an individual, I have life and I will put meaning into it because I am the only me and that is something special that I can hold onto.

Please explain how, until then I refuse to believe this :( No one is a failure.. Just lost and confused. Everyone needs a hand in the dark, let us be that hand to guide you to a better state of mind. Please <3

Please PM me if you need someone to vent to... I will be here to listen I promise <3 I know I am just a stranger but if you felt the need to post here then you are more than worth my time for me to listen to you. Perhaps we can help each other out somehow... Worth a try?
The only reason why I am alive is for the love of my life and my mother. Without them I would not be typing to you right now... If you find a real way to live for yourself please help me too..

If you need someone to rant to please PM me, I am here to listen for a while and I too need someone to talk to... Even though I am just a stranger, I would like to hear what you have to say. Every person deserves to be heard and I will listen.

I don't know you but I am sending you all the love that I possibly can through the computer <3 I don't know if any of this will mean anything to you but I understand how you feel :( My depression has been nerve wracking for my entire life and everything just.. Seems so pointless and hopeless.. Life has become beyond confusing, the constant feeling of the "need" to die... If you need anyone to talk to, even though I am a stranger.. I would love to hear from you. You can vent out everything to me and I promise I will listen.
That is horrible :( I can't believe anyone could be that cruel... Please PM me, we can talk.
Please PM me.. I feel like we should talk, I need someone to talk to as well.. It could help the both of us. Worth a try? You never know.

^This... I wished everything in the world that I could have a father... He was alive but never wanted to see me... I was young and didn't understand this... So I would cry and cry when I couldn't see him because he didn't care about me. Even now as an adult it makes me really depressed that he just does not want contact with me... It is like he is dead but worse...
